text:
London gets much more rain than hot, dry cities such as Cairo (about 25 mm a year), Dubai and Riyadh (about 100 mm each), Las Vegas (about 120 mm), and Los Angeles (about 370 mm), against roughly 600 mm in London. Madrid (about 440 mm) is also drier than London. These are approximate long-term averages from memory, not checked against a live source.

CONFIDENCE: 82
